findings.where: scripts/provision.sh / scripts/lib/wsl.sh (systemd-resolved left enabled); src/ossbot/ctl/render.py:198-215; tests/system/test_egress_per_uid.sh:22-53; src/ossbot/ctl/doctor.py:248-275
findings.title: DNS exfiltration through systemd-resolved IPC (varlink /run/systemd/resolve/io.systemd.Resolve 0666 and D-Bus org.freedesktop.resolve1) for every service uid, past OSSBOT-OUT
findings.fix: Mask systemd-resolved in an idempotent provision step (disable --now + mask, changed/unchanged; resolv.conf is the WSL file naming 10.255.255.254, nothing needs resolved). Add per-uid varlink and D-Bus ResolveHostname probes (expect failure; root control still resolves) to test_egress_per_uid.sh and doctor's per-uid check, have doctor/watchdog flag resolved unmasked/active, and record it in an ADR-0005 addendum.

findings.title: Root kill followed by a resume within one 10 s housekeeping tick never reaches reconcile, so an armed approval and its confirm token survive
findings.fix: Invalidate armed/confirmed in request_resume() when a kill flag exists and in reconcile() whenever offline resume.log entries are read; correct the comment that nothing can be armed while killed (ApprovalService.approve has no running check, only the Telegram handler).

findings.title: Watchdog lifecycle 'down' exemption ignores scope: a workers-scope down (gatekeeper still running, persists across reboots) disables the gatekeeper-unhealthy pause and restart_failed
findings.fix: Exempt only scope == 'distro', or keep check_health for the workers scope.

findings.title: Configurable drain timeout is honoured only by ossctl down: down.ps1 caps at a hard-coded 120+90 s and the unit drain/stop timeouts are static
findings.fix: Either cap lifecycle.drain_timeout_s at 120, or make down.ps1 use the effective value and render the sandboxd drain env + TimeoutStopSec (drop-in) from the policy so TimeoutStopSec >= drain + 30 s holds for any value.

findings.title: app-deploy reported 'rsync (1 items)' changed and restarted four units with no deploy-source file newer than the previous unchanged run; only the count is logged, so the cause cannot be traced
findings.fix: Log the itemized rsync lines to the provision log and ignore metadata-only differences (e.g. --omit-dir-times or a content checksum) so they do not trigger uv sync and service restarts.
